selected_gaps.gap: At the frontier leaf represented by arxiv:2605.13208v1, no retrieved work establishes whether candidate-source ordering remains valid when a single-UAV trajectory samples a turbulent plume whose observed-to-modeled relation changes across intermittent regimes rather than remaining globally monotone — stakes: a source can be ranked below a geometrically incompatible rival before accumulation, wasting the fixed flight budget and making conclusions from monotone-sensor evaluations fail to transfer to held-out GADEN houses.
selected_gaps.selection_rationale: This is the most load-bearing method gap because it asks for a pre-accumulation construction that repairs the candidate ordering which both Bayesian updating and action valuation inherit. generative_process_redesign treats the inherited assignment of candidate identities to the current likelihood-value multiset as a free pre-Bayesian component and redesigns that assignment from truth-blind regime-replicated source-over-carrier evidence, rather than returning to occupied global ranks, covariance whitening, robust residuals, or change detection.

selected_gaps.gap: At the frontier leaf represented by arxiv:2601.07445v1, no retrieved work determines from truth-blind observed and candidate-field evidence when turbulent correlation contains source-discriminative structure and when it instead produces spurious agreement, so the same dependence can help one regime and reverse evidence in another — stakes: practitioners cannot preregister a safe activation boundary, while the field cannot tell whether reported gains reflect recovered source information or a house-specific correlation artifact.
selected_gaps.selection_rationale: Under a shared-object thread, this leg probes the same truth-blind regime-partitioned candidate–observation concordance used by the anchor; removing it makes the promised offline falsification and safe activation boundary unrunnable. controlled_diagnostic_design holds candidate support and sampled observations fixed while contrasting informative versus spurious correlation strata, separating genuine reordering from house-specific agreement artifacts.

deliverable_coverage: method — anchor gap → generative_process_redesign yields the runnable pre-Bayesian likelihood-assignment operator.

user_direction_disposition.user_wanted: The M3 mechanism must act before Bayesian accumulation or action selection, change the relative ordering of source evidence or actions, use the existing carrier/source likelihood fields and GADEN observations without truth leakage, and admit a preregistered offline falsification gate before runtime integration.
user_direction_disposition.chosen: A truth-blind regime-decomposed pre-Bayesian evidence-ordering operator on existing carrier/source fields, coupled to a controlled offline activation and falsification diagnostic.

generative_process_redesign.selection_note: untested lane — differentiation_from_lit must substantively defend the choice

deferred_gaps.gap: Across the retrieved Bayesian frontier leaves, no work tests whether accumulated candidate-conditioned observation contributions may be treated as arising from one stationary evidence relation once the UAV moves through distinct plume regimes — stakes: if this inherited assumption is false, nominally sharper posteriors and information-gain actions can be confidently wrong, and published comparisons of planners rest on a belief-transition model whose validity is unexamined.
